question: If \(a=1,\) \(b=10,\) \(c=100\) and \(d=1000,\) then \[ \begin{aligned} &(a+b+c-d)+(a+b-c+d)\\ &\quad+(a-b+c+d)\\ &\quad+(-a+b+c+d) \end{aligned} \] is equal to
solution:
Each of \(a,b,c,d\) appears positively in three parentheses and negatively in one. Thus each has total coefficient \(3-1=2\). The expression simplifies to
\[
\begin{aligned}
2(a+b+c+d)
&=2(1+10+100+1000)\\
&=2(1111)=2222.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is \(2222\), choice B.
